operation.summary: A batch of Curation Partners API requests in one, each a whole request frisket cannot see.
Lists curated packages owned by the specified curator.
Gets a curated package given its resource name.
List the data segments owned by a curator.
Creates a data segment owned by the listed curator.
operation.description: Creates a data segment owned by the listed curator. The data segment will be created in the `ACTIVE` state, meaning it will be immediately available for buyers to use in preferred deals, private auction deals, and auction packages.

operation.summary: Gets a data segment given its name.
Gets the latest state of a long-running operation.
operation.description: Gets the latest state of a long-running operation. Clients can use this method to poll the operation result at intervals as recommended by the API service.

operation.summary: Returns the result rows from a completed report.
operation.description: Returns the result rows from a completed report. The caller must have previously called `RunReport` and waited for that operation to complete. The rows will be returned according to the order specified by the `sorts` member of the report definition.

operation.summary: Initiates the execution of an existing report asynchronously.
operation.description: Initiates the execution of an existing report asynchronously. Users can get the report by polling this operation using `OperationsService.GetOperation`. Poll every 5 seconds initially, with an exponential backoff. Once a report is complete, the operation will contain a `RunReportResponse` in its response field containing a report_result that can be passed to the `FetchReportResultRows` method to retrieve the report data.

operation.summary: Lists all media planner accounts that the caller has access to.
operation.description: Lists all media planner accounts that the caller has access to. For curators, this will return all media planners that have accepted curator terms. For other accounts, attempting to list media planners will return an error.
